review_mode: Independent semantic regression read of five actually recorded live UI/API answers. This is not a model-blind comparison or a new live model run. The selected recipe and parent report were visible; verdicts were independently checked against each claim's own returned exact quotations and immutable source evidence.
limitations: Five answers cover three unique questions, including repeated before/after/Developer Juniper checks; this is targeted live UI smoke coverage, not the held-out 45-case evaluation.
Quotation counts include exact deterministic source-title context as well as substantive source paragraphs; they are not 27 distinct factual claims.

Browser file-picker upload was blocked by the extension environment and is not claimed as passing. The parent report documents actual API upload and subsequent UI behavior; this review evaluates saved answers, not new browser interactions.
No paid calls, runtime database writes, parent UI report edits or source changes were performed.
